faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification for CSSD Officer and Executive Engineer (Civil) positions has been released by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Rishikesh (AIIMS Rishikesh) for filling up 2 vacancies in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under this notification, comprising 1 post for CSSD Officer and 1 post for Executive Engineer (Civil) on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Rishikesh various posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications through offline mode only. The completed application form must be sent via Speed Post or Registered Post to the designated recruitment cell address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the filled application form along with all required supporting documents at AIIMS Rishikesh is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for CSSD Officer and Executive Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for both posts will be placed in Level 11, drawing a salary range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for these deputation posts at AIIMS Rishikesh is set at 56 years as on the closing date of the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What are the eligibility qualifications for the CSSD Officer post?
faq.answer: Officers of Central/State Govt/Autonomous/Statutory Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or CSSD Supervisors with 5 to 7 years of regular service in specific grade pays, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What are the eligibility criteria for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be officers under Central/State/U.T. Governments, Universities, or Autonomous Bodies holding analogous posts, or Assistant/Junior Engineers in civil engineering with requisite years of regular service.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the offline application be sent?
faq.answer: The application form filled in the prescribed format, along with attested copies of CRs, vigilance clearance, and certificates, must be sent to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, Pin-249203.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the CSSD Officer and Executive Engineer (Civil) positions will be carried out through short-listing based on candidate bio-data followed by a personal interview.
